MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 31

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

3. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 10

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

10. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 6
   D. 11

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

13. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

16. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. A — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625
5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
